descriptionText:
Item Details:
Title: 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy)
Volume: 35
Author: 蛭田達也 (Tatsuya Hiruta)
Publisher: 東立出版社 (Tong Li Comics)
Language: Traditional Chinese
ISBN: 957-34-0191-6
Format: Paperback
Price printed on back: NT$65 / HK$25 / US$3
Condition: Very Good — crisp pages, bright cover with minimal edge wear. No rips, stains, or writing.
Edition: Official licensed Chinese edition (正式授權中文版 / 少年系列)
🖼️ Description:
This is Volume 35 of Kung Fu Boy (功夫旋風兒), the classic martial arts manga series by Tatsuya Hiruta (蛭田達也). Published by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社) in Taiwan, this traditional Chinese edition is part of the official licensed release of the hit shōnen manga.
This volume features the protagonist in a relaxed pose wearing a “KILL GUN” rock-themed T-shirt and jeans with patches, showing a stylish and confident side of the character between intense martial arts adventures.
